new file mode 100644
index 0000000..20849fd
--- /dev/null
+++ b/reproduce_bug.py
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+from dynaconf import Dynaconf, get_history
+from pprint import pprint
+import os
+
+# Create settings.toml
+with open("settings.toml", "w") as f:
+    f.write('[default]\n\n[a]\n b = "foo"\n c = "bar"\n d = "@format {this.a.b} {this.a.c}"\n')
+
+settings = Dynaconf(settings_files=["settings.toml"])
+
+def main() -> None:
+    pprint(settings.as_dict())
+    print(f"Expecting to get the history of key 'a.d' with value {settings['a']['d']}")
+    try:
+        pprint(get_history(settings, "a.d"))
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"Caught exception: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
+        import traceback
+        traceback.print_exc()
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
